correctness.rationale: The lower bound for sets of at most four points follows from \(s+\binom{s}{2}(p-2)\). For \(p=7\), a five-point set with a collinear triple covers at most 39 points outside the set; a five-point arc has 50 external secant incidences and at least seven distinct duplicated incidences, so it covers at most 43 of the 44 external points. The explicit witnesses cover \(T_5\) and \(T_7\), and verify.py confirms their coverage using exact arithmetic.
